item.description:
The Unintended Consequences of Premium Subsidies in Health Insurance
Individual premium subsidies are intended as a social policy tool for low-income households. Yet they also create incentives for beneficiaries to choose lower deductibles and, as a result, consume more medical services than may be necessary.
15.07.2026
